sloka: राघवो नर शार्दूल विषम् उप्त्वा द्विजिह्ववत् ।विचरिष्यति कैकेयी निर्मुक्ता इव हि पन्नगी ॥२-४३-२॥
transliteration: rāghavo nara śārdūla viṣam uptvā dvijihvavat ।vicariṣyati kaikeyī nirmuktā iva hi pannagī ॥2-43-2॥

translations.english: Moving crookedly like a snake, Kaikeyi has released her venom on Rama, the best among men. Now she will move about freely like a sheserpent that has cast off its slough.
translations.hindi: आपका पुत्र तो गुणवान्‌ और पुरूषश्रेष्ठ लिए आप दीन होकर, क्यों इतना बिलाप हैं
